content: FastAPI BackgroundTasks is in-process, fire-and-forget, loses tasks on restart, no retries - fine only for trivial jobs, not ML inference. arq (asyncio-native, Redis-backed) integrates naturally with FastAPI's async stack and is recommended for small-to-mid apps needing durable background YOLO inference jobs with minimal ops overhead. Celery wins only at larger scale (10+ task types, multi-worker fleets, broker failover, Kubernetes) which is overkill for an early-stage project.
